Most smart home lighting comes in the form of smaller bulbs and plug-in adapters, but as the market matures, we're starting to see fully recessed light fixtures that integrate natively with Apple Home via Matter. SwitchBot recently launched its new SwitchBot RGBICWW Ceiling Light, bringing ultra-bright illumination and native Matter support directly to your ceiling fixture.

HomeKit Weekly is a column focused on smart home accessories, automation tips, and everything related to Apple's smart home framework.

Native Matter and Apple Home integration

The most important feature of this new ceiling light is that it supports Matter right out of the box, without the need for a SwitchBot Hub. As long as your Apple TV 4K or HomePod stays online, the light can connect directly to your existing smart home ecosystem over a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

Hardware size and brightness

SwitchBot offers two sizes to suit different use cases. The 12-inch model is ideal for hallways and bathrooms, delivering 2,000 lumens, while the larger 15-inch model is designed for living rooms and bedrooms, producing 3,200 lumens. The SwitchBot features built-in stepless dimming from 100% down to 0%.

Most smart bulbs typically limit you to a single colour at a time. Because this light uses RGBIC technology with individual chips, it can display multiple colours simultaneously across the ceiling, creating dynamic lighting effects. If you prefer a more traditional look, the fixture also includes dedicated warm and cool white LEDs, allowing you to adjust the colour temperature from 2700K to 6500K. Additionally, it features a power-off memory function, meaning that after a brief power interruption, the light will retain your previously set brightness and colour. I absolutely love this feature, because

SwitchBot RGBICWW impressions

Using a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi connection means adding another long-term bandwidth-consuming client to your router. It would have been nice to have built-in Thread wireless capability, which would provide near-instantaneous response within a mesh network. However, being able to get a recessed ceiling light with native Matter support for under $50 is an exceptional value for anyone looking to permanently upgrade their ceiling lighting.

You can purchase the new SwitchBot RGBICWW on Amazon.
